status: Valid completed comparison; normal streaming performance target missed
interpretation: All 12 attempts and all 6 alternating pairs pass, verifying 21,600 ordered updates. All 1,953 harness files, assets, runtime helpers, lockfiles, packaged fixtures and 12 backend logs remain exact. The disposable runtime is removed, with no remaining owned process.
Streaming history requests fall 90.567% and decoded history bytes fall 90.500% by median paired reduction. Both improve in all 6 pairs. Resets fall to zero.
Reduced-motion idle main-thread work per second falls 61.179%, and renderer CPU falls 53.152%, in all 6 pairs. Running animations fall from 60 to 0.

Normal streaming regresses: main-thread work per second rises 3.426%, script time rises 55.647%, and frame-gap p95 rises 59.832% by median paired change. All 6 pairs regress on these measures. Median frame-gap p95 grows from 83.4 ms to 141.7 ms.

Streaming style time falls 14.181% and layout time falls 27.323% in all 6 pairs. These changes do not offset the script and frame regression. Long-task totals fall while frame gaps worsen. Lower long-task totals alone do not establish responsiveness.
Normal idle main-thread work per second rises 2.986% by median paired change, with 4 of 6 pairs worse. Renderer CPU is mixed and effectively flat.

Cold asset encoded bytes fall 77.614%. Cold readiness is mixed: 3 pairs improve and 3 regress, with median paired change 0.274% worse. A lower standalone candidate median does not establish a stable cold-load gain.

Visible history remains at 100 messages in each of 6 sessions on both builds. Streaming DOM medians are 26,359 and 26,378, with 6 mounted editors in both. A smaller candidate view does not explain the comparison.
limits: This is the 44cf Grid build at 1x, with the v2 correctness observer on both arms. Do not pool it with v1, private diagnostic or older-build timings.
The 20% streaming task-time goal is not met. Nineteen other matrix cases remain pending.
These are Linux Chromium results on Intel i7-11700T, 16 logical cores and about 31 GiB memory. They do not establish direct M2 Air, INP, battery or leak results.
Normal streaming needs fresh JavaScript attribution before another performance change.
A separate, unverified post-input return-boundary probe is queued after this frozen run. It is not a finding from this benchmark.
